answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the vault of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch, rewards vest against future work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Every claim climbs the glacier of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the canyon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
